items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I can remember when we used to work with Irene

ctx.x: All of these cats went over to Honolulu. Anyway, we played around Chicago. This band became very, very good, and we worked in this little club, and the crowds were great, you know, so after this -- this must have been about 1932, the latter part of '32, because as I said before, Or I think I said to you, you know, after that then we joined Louis Armstrong.
However, you know, back in those days I can remember when we used to work with Irene (Eddy, Budd. and she was working -- we had -- the jobs paid like ten, $12.00 a week.
Tell us a little bit about Irene (Eddy, Budd.
